tags: Scores higher for video creators whose content receives more reactions and zaps (kinds 21, 22, 34235, 34236).
content:
plan
  videos = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [21, 22, 34235, 34236], authors: [_.targetPubkey], limit: 50}
in then
  events = videos | [],
  n = length(events),
  videoIds = map(events, fn(e ~> fetch(e, .id))),
  reactions = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [7], '#e': videoIds, limit: 100},
  zaps = do 'nostr.query' {kinds: [9735], '#e': videoIds, limit: 100}
in
let
  rList = reactions | [],
  zList = zaps | [],
  total = length(rList) + length(zList)
in
if n == 0 then 0.0
else if total > 100 then 1.0
else if total > 50 then 0.85
else if total > 20 then 0.7
else if total > 5 then 0.5
else if total > 0 then 0.25
else 0.0
